stories.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceX
stories.take: xAI's coding agent leaked confidential files, including SpaceX material — a sharp warning about giving AI tools broad file access.

stories.title: Ring cameras go mobile as Amazon debuts AI-powered security drone and robot
stories.take: Ring's cameras now move: an AI security drone and a roaming robot take Amazon's home surveillance off the wall.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
stories.take: OpenAI buys travel startup Odessia — another step from chatbot toward booking and doing things for you.

stories.title: The US military seems to be getting nervous about the launch supply crunch
stories.take: The Pentagon is worried there aren't enough rockets to go around — launch capacity is now a national-security bottleneck.

stories.title: DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
stories.take: DeepMind pushes Gemini into robots and opens a safety benchmark named for Asimov — capability and guardrails in the same release.

stories.title: Nvidia has a Jensen Huang problem—and no obvious successor
stories.take: Nvidia's Huang problem deepens: the company has no obvious successor while its CEO sits at the center of a growing scandal.

stories.title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement
stories.take: X launches native clipping to keep creators and their best moments on-platform instead of sending traffic elsewhere.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
stories.take: New York's AI safety law is now in effect: major labs must register, disclose safety practices and report critical incidents or face fines.

stories.title: OpenAI Gives Brands Some Data About How They Appear in ChatGPT
stories.take: Brands finally get a peek at how ChatGPT talks about them — the first real measurement layer for AI discovery.

stories.title: OpenAI’s new business agents give brands a free way into the conversation it’s also selling as an ad
stories.take: Brands get a free route into ChatGPT via business agents — but OpenAI keeps the data and the recommendations.

stories.title: Adobe unveils Photoshop 2027 with a host of new AI features
stories.take: Photoshop 2027 leans hard into AI to cut the busywork — the open question is how much control editors keep.

stories.title: Adobe's Google partnership hints at a radically different future for Photoshop
stories.take: Adobe's Google tie-up points to a Photoshop that lives in the cloud and the browser, not just on the desktop.

stories.title: Amid a difficult transitional year, The Trade Desk posts a rare quarterly revenue decline
stories.take: The Trade Desk posts a rare revenue decline in a transitional year — and says it is now eyeing M&A.

stories.title: X Previews Labels That Tell Users Why Its AI System Flagged Their Posts
stories.take: X will label why its AI flagged a post — a small transparency step for a system users usually can't see into.

stories.title: Skydance to Embrace Bundling Across Business Functions
stories.take: Skydance plans to bundle across its business after the merger — scale and packaging over standalone bets.

stories.take: Manager of the Year is settled: Will Venable in the AL, and Pat Murphy three-peats in the NL for Milwaukee.

stories.take: Two 22-year-olds take Rookie of the Year: McGonigle in the AL, Stewart in the NL.

stories.take: Bob Boone — seven Gold Gloves, a World Series ring, and the middle of MLB's first three-generation family — dies at 78.

stories.title: Dodgers hire Pedro Guerrero away from Marlins as hitting coach
stories.take: The Dodgers poach hitting coach Pedro Guerrero from Miami as their offseason staff shuffle continues.

stories.take: The House votes to effectively end the Hegseth impeachment effort — the Pentagon chief survives, for now.

stories.take: House Republicans pick Jim Jordan as minority leader after their midterm defeats, while Senate Republicans keep John Thune.

stories.take: Inflation rose 0.4% in October — gas dipped below $4, but food, energy and housing costs still strain households.

stories.take: The U.S. charges three men with plotting attacks on an air base and Jewish communities.

stories.take: The Kennedy family sues to block Trump's gilded arch, saying it would cast a shadow over JFK's grave site.

stories.take: L.A. County supervisors vote to expose the scope and influence of sheriff's deputy gangs.

stories.title: Sony Says Next-Gen Console is On Schedule - Kinda Funny Games Daily 11.06.26
stories.take: GTA 6 is confirmed targeting 30 FPS on every console, with PS5 Pro ray-tracing upgrades — the hosts expected no more and hope a next-gen edition hits 60 • House House admits it used AI sparingly on Big Walk after 19 IGF jurors pledged to reject any game using generative AI • BioWare co-founder Trent Oster and James Ohlen want to reunite to save BioWare's IP after EA closed the studio and canceled Mass Effect • PlayStation kills its PC streaming app Dec. 10 — under 0.4% of Premium members used it

stories.title: LAUSD responds to Google's AI requirements, Fixing the crumbling San Clemente coastline, Samuel Oschin Air and Space Center debuts Friday—Afternoon Edition
stories.take: LAUSD is reviewing Google's ultimatum — search with AI enabled or no search at all — against its moratorium on student generative AI; its AI committee meets Friday • The Coastal Commission approved a seawall for San Clemente's crumbling rail corridor (closed 12+ months since 2021), with ~700,000 cubic yards of sand and $300M+ secured, over environmental objections • The Samuel Oschin Air and Space Center opens Friday with Endeavour in full launch stack — 30 astronauts attend, including Mark Kelly

stories.title: Hegseth faces impeachment effort
stories.take: Rep. Thomas Massie brings eight articles against Hegseth: three say the Iran war is illegal without congressional authorization, one cites the school strike that killed 200+, others cover Venezuela, Yemen, the drug-boat strikes and alleged retaliation against Sen. Mark Kelly • Hegseth calls it a disgruntled congressman's agenda and says everything was lawful; Trump is defending him, not cutting him loose • The House math could work — unified Democrats plus a few Republicans, helped by GOP attendance problems — then the Senate could try, refuse or delay it

stories.title: Fable 5.2 Is the Best AI Ever. So Why Am I Not Switching Yet?
stories.take: The answer: he's not switching for most work — Fable 5.2 is spiky, unmatched on big open-ended projects handed off end-to-end, but Opus 5.5 is as good, cheaper and less annoying for everyday tasks, and Fable can't judge what humans find interesting • It doubled Opus 5.5 on the Remote Labor Index (41.3% vs. 21%) and tops the AA Intelligence Index at 65 • Anthropic's demos: a working OS built by 1,000+ subagents in 8 days, two black-hole problems solved, and Fermat's Last Theorem fully formalized • Cost is the catch: $26.54 per task at max effort, 2.6× Opus 5.5

stories.title: Hotter-Than-Expected Inflation Data Has Investors Betting on a Rate Hike
stories.take: CPI rose 0.4% in October (~4% year over year by WSJ analysis, 5.7% annualized over three months) and broadened beyond fuel — TVs +3.3% in a month on AI-boom electronics • Dallas Fed's Logan floated a half-point December hike; the 10-year briefly touched 5% and Nvidia fell another 5.5% • Anthropic's IPO targets ~$1.3T with each of seven founders cashing out ~$250M • Record beef prices are here for years: smallest cattle herd in 70+ years, record demand, and no sign consumers will switch proteins

stories.title: Yiyun Li’s new novel imagines forgotten 18th century prodigies
stories.take: Nvidia has fallen from ~$5.8T to ~$4T as Huang's affair fallout grows; the board wants to keep him, and his pro-China advocacy — including pressure that stalled the Megaspeed probe — is being re-read • With Prop. 40 dead and Prop. 38 sending $8B+ to one tiny institute, Joe Mathews argues California's initiative system has run on money since 1911 and needs counter-proposals and plain-language drafting • Yiyun Li's Music Against the Night revives John Field, inventor of the nocturne, and his wife Adelaide — music as an argument with finality

stories.title: Inflation just won't quit
stories.take: October inflation was hot and broad — headline +0.4%, core +0.3%, ~4% year over year — as diesel costs bleed into food and services; with wages just above 3%, consumers fall behind and a December Fed hike looks all but certain • Some November relief: WTI ~$86, gas back below $4, though damaged refineries may not recover until 2028 • Agentic holiday shopping is still tiny — some retailers report single-digit agent transactions — and one experiment held 20 RealReal items hostage for hours • Markets: Dow 52,231, Nasdaq 25,065, S&P 7,520; credit card balances hit a record near $1.3T
